milestones.title: Types, constants and language mappings
milestones.verify: Check field/value/layout contracts and Bend ownership adaptations; connect each type/constant to its consuming API fixtures.

milestones.title: Numeric fidelity and scalar contracts
milestones.verify: Exact integer/bit-pattern vectors and operation-specific floating-point contracts, including the retained default-resampling precision counterexamples.

milestones.title: Vectors, matrices and quaternions
milestones.verify: Compare values, orientation conventions, singular/zero cases, interpolation and transforms against the pinned raymath functions.

milestones.title: Buffers, memory and callback contracts
milestones.verify: Prove sizes/content and allocation/error/ownership lifecycles; make native-buffer and callback adaptations explicit.

milestones.title: Files, paths, compression and data utilities
milestones.verify: Temporary-file fixtures, exact bytes/path results, missing/truncated input, compression round trips and resource closure.

milestones.title: Random-number and sequence contracts
milestones.verify: Fixed-seed output sequences, inclusive ranges, uniqueness/sequence ownership and overflow boundaries.

milestones.title: Colors and pixel formats
milestones.verify: Exact channel/packing conversions, alpha/tint/blending, every format and quantization boundary.

milestones.title: Image creation, primitives and transformations
milestones.verify: Compare dimensions and every output pixel across formats, clipping, winding/endpoint rules, ownership and degenerate inputs.

milestones.title: Precision-correct crop, resize and composition
milestones.verify: Exact reference pixels for cropping/scaling/filtering, alpha/hidden RGB, edge extension, coefficient rounding and source preservation.

milestones.title: Image codecs and export
milestones.verify: Per-format decode/encode fixtures, metadata, truncated/malformed data, dimensions and resource limits.

milestones.title: Window, monitor, clipboard and cursor runtime
milestones.verify: Real per-platform lifecycle/state/monitor/DPI/clipboard/cursor integration; normalized event traces and error cases.

milestones.title: Keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch and gestures
milestones.verify: Deterministic pressed/held/released and gesture traces plus real device/platform integration and disconnect handling.

milestones.title: Timing, frame control and automation
milestones.verify: Controlled clocks/frame-event replay and real pacing/event-polling/lifecycle checks, including manual frame control.

milestones.title: rlgl state, matrices and immediate drawing
milestones.verify: State-transition traces and equivalent rendered output for required graphics backends; matrix stack and batching lifecycle.

milestones.title: 2D drawing and splines
milestones.verify: Controlled framebuffer comparisons, clipping/AA/blend semantics, cameras and representative shape/spline examples.

milestones.title: Textures, render targets and sampling
milestones.verify: Texture upload/readback, sampling/filter/wrap, render targets, mipmaps and repeated resource lifecycle under real graphics backends.

milestones.title: Shaders, uniforms and programmable effects
milestones.verify: Shader loading/diagnostics, uniform/state behavior and equivalent effects; resolve the complete GLSL compatibility contract.

milestones.title: Byte strings and Unicode/codepoint utilities
milestones.verify: Exact strings/codepoints/counts, malformed UTF-8, buffer lifetimes, delimiters, allocation and truncation behavior.

milestones.title: Fonts, glyphs and text drawing
milestones.verify: Per-font-format glyph/metrics/layout/raster output, atlas/export behavior, default fonts and font resource lifetime.

milestones.title: Wave and music formats
milestones.verify: Decoded PCM, metadata, format conversion and malformed/truncated audio for every reference format.

milestones.title: Audio devices and sound playback
milestones.verify: Offline mixing values plus device lifecycle, volume/pitch/pan, errors and playback-state integration.

milestones.title: Music streams and audio callbacks
milestones.verify: Stream/callback ordering, PCM continuity, seeking/looping, queue/backpressure, underruns and resource closure.

milestones.title: Meshes, model loading and 3D drawing
milestones.verify: Mesh/model data, transforms, topology, import/export, rendered scenes and allocation/upload/unload lifecycles.

milestones.title: Materials and texture maps
milestones.verify: Material/map assignment, defaults, imports and rendered results, with explicit shared-resource ownership.

milestones.title: Model animation and skinning
milestones.verify: Skeleton/pose/frame data, interpolation, CPU/GPU skinning, compatibility errors and animation lifetimes.

milestones.title: 2D/3D collision and ray queries
milestones.verify: Exact Boolean/topology results and defined numerical tolerances for contacts/distances, boundaries and degenerate shapes.

milestones.title: Camera controls and projection
milestones.verify: Controlled motion/input traces, handedness, view/projection and screen/world conversions for all camera modes.

milestones.title: VR stereo configuration and rendering
milestones.verify: Device/config values, eye transforms/projections, stereo rendering and configuration lifecycle.

milestones.title: rlgl buffers, compute and low-level interop
milestones.verify: Buffer/VAO/SSBO/framebuffer state and data, compute synchronization, native interop and supported-backend conditions.

milestones.title: Build switches, limits and source-package compatibility
milestones.verify: Check every declared configuration/default/conditional variant and its consuming feature; record language/package adaptations rather than silently dropping C glue.

milestones.title: Complete platform/backend validation
milestones.verify: Run actual lifecycle/device/graphics/audio/packaging and resource/performance tests on each applicable supported target.
